title: Gaban
desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

title: Waqt Ki Deewar
desc: A cruel and lustful man brutally rapes a woman, forcing her to commit suicide, leaving her young children homeless. The children try to stay together but are separated. Years later, one of them has taken to a life of crime with a friend, who, unbeknownst to him, is none other than his mother's rapist.

title: Loha
desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

title: Guddu
desc: Guddu and Salina meet with an accident and she loses her eyesight. Later, when Guddu learns that he is terminally ill, he decides to donate his eyes to her, but his father disapproves.
